posts.com:
>>9781
I know it sucks to be in this boat. I am too. Ive never had a girlfriend either. But its not too late. You're 23. Your whole life is ahead of you.

If you have no skills, first step is admitting this, but you cant just wallow in it. Before anything else learn to cook if you cant already. Just basic things like scrambled eggs, rice and pasta.

Genuinely learning to weld is a good skill. If you have some one in your wider family who knows how to they could show you and you could make a lot of money.

Also lifes not just all about money. Take a deep breath. Close this site. Just sit there for a moment and think. I know life seems like it sucks right now but I promise you it will get better.

Reach out to your friends. If you dont have any reach out to your family or brother or cousins or uncle or whatever. Social connection is key. It lets you forget for a moment the way the world is. You just feel free. Im sure theres at least one person you could spend time with and just feel happy with.

If lifes getting that bad, call in sick to work. Its okay to be sick for one day in almost all jobs. Take today to relax.

Also get a good sleep. 8 hours at least. And if youre using porn or any drugs, except caffeine, stop. Theyre in your brain telling you to destroy yourself. Stop them.

Saging before goretards fill up this thread.
